svg.title: The flow, in files
svg.desc: The context-v cycle as folders. Explorations lead to specs, directly or down through decisions; one spec leads to many plans, then loops (as a team) or prompts (solo). Each working session ends in a handoff the next session picks up from, and all of it leads to reflection. Reflection leads to issues, which become reminders, blueprints, and agent skills; those converge into the next cycle, which feeds back into explorations, specs, and plans. Explorations open the cycle; issues close it.
svg.text: 02 / Learn: what the cycle taught us
